summary: Complete testing of Support V2 Features - all 6 improvements verified. Backend API returns extended stats (today_count, in_analysis, awaiting_reply, urgent_count, types_breakdown). Frontend Admin shows 4-card stats dashboard and types breakdown section. Quick templates functionality works correctly. Support form has improved multi-line placeholder. Confirmation message shows human-friendly text. Email templates contain CTA block linking to main journey.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Support V2 features fully tested. Key additions: (1) CTA in emails - get_support_cta_block() links to main journey, (2) Stats dashboard - 4 cards in admin: today_count, in_analysis, awaiting_reply, urgent_count, (3) Types breakdown - aggregates last 7 days by ticket_type, (4) Quick templates - QUICK_TEMPLATES array with 4 options, (5) Improved placeholder - multi-line text in description textarea, (6) Human confirmation - 'A nossa equipa ja esta a analisar' message. features_verified.details: get_support_cta_block() fetches main journey and generates CTA with 'Contribuir para este sonho' link. Included in admin reply, status change, resolved, and closed emails.
4 cards displayed: Pedidos hoje (today_count), Em analise (in_analysis), A aguardar resposta (awaiting_reply), Urgentes (urgent_count). All values from API.
Button 'Inserir resposta rapida' opens menu with 4 templates: Em analise, Pedir detalhes, Resolvido?, Sugestao registada. Clicking inserts text into reply input.
Section 'Pedidos por tipo (ultimos 7 dias)' shows breakdown with type badges and counts. Uses MongoDB aggregation with 7-day $gte filter.
Description textarea placeholder: 'Explica-nos o que aconteceu. Se possivel, indica o passo onde ocorreu o problema... Tambem podes anexar uma screenshot...'
After ticket creation: 'A nossa equipa ja esta a analisar. Normalmente respondemos em poucas horas.'
